electron44Patch.scope: Restores the Electron 44 clipboard adaptation that ShunCode 0.7.4 actually shipped. The logic is transcribed from the unminified out/main.js of the installed product (see docs/evidence/clipboard-adaptation.json), not invented here. Type annotations and three `as Blob` narrowings are reconstructed, because types are erased during compilation and cannot be recovered from the shipped JavaScript.
electron44Patch.electronChange: Electron 44.0.0 removed 13 clipboard methods and made the rest async.

edits.why: Electron 44 moves the selection buffer to clipboard.selection; add the helper the call sites use
readText became async; selection buffer reached via clipboard.selection
clipboard.readImage() removed; read images via ClipboardItem blobs
writeText became async; selection buffer reached via clipboard.selection
clipboard.writeBuffer() removed; custom formats go through ClipboardItem
clipboard.readBuffer() removed; read custom formats via ClipboardItem
has() became async; namespaced format matches writeClipboardBuffer
clipboard.write() now takes ClipboardItem[] with MIME-typed entries
AuthenticationResponseDetails shape changed; interface extension became invalid
ClipboardItem must be imported to construct clipboard entries
ClipboardItem and nativeImage must be imported to construct clipboard entries

conclusion: Carrier builds from upstream sources with the shipped Electron version. Repackaging a full ShunCode is therefore feasible in principle; the remaining work is applying the author's own customisations.
